first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: teal stadium seating
entities.identification: Large sections of teal stadium seating arranged in the stands, interspersed with stairs, passageways, and light-colored railings.

entities.name: pink-purple illuminated racing gate set
entities.identification: A set of pink-purple illuminated rectangular or angled-frame facilities near the sideline opening.

entities.name: green stadium turf
entities.identification: A broad area of green turf in the stadium, immediately adjacent to the gray sideline passageway, with variations in light and dark across its surface.

entities.name: gray sideline passageway
entities.identification: A long, narrow gray paved surface between the turf and the stands, with a yellow line extending into the depth visible in the latter half.

entities.name: Object L
entities.identification: A white-pink pentagonal gate with a thick frame on the turf, featuring a hollow opening and pink feet at the bottom.

entities.name: Object M
entities.identification: A cyan-blue illuminated pillar facility at the far end of the passageway, to the right of the pink-purple illuminated racing gate set, with an opening between the pillars.

entities.name: Object N
entities.identification: A tall-pole facility composed of yellow rods, featuring two tall upright poles, a connecting crossbar, and curved supports below; parts of the rod surfaces glow pink-white.

entities.name: stadium floodlight strip
entities.identification: A row of bright white lights and overexposed light clusters above the stadium.

entities.name: upper-level black display screen
entities.identification: A dark rectangular screen high above, with bright light-colored text-like patterns and circular bright spots on it.

entities.name: teal low sideline wall
entities.identification: A teal wall strip extending along the lower edge of the stands and the sideline passageway, locally divided by access openings.
